description: MainActivity.kt: Android activity implementing speech recognition with UI components, permission handling, and recognition listener setup.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity class managing speech recognition UI and logic, including permission checks and recognition listener implementation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, UI components, speech recognizer, recognizer intent, and button click behavior.

methods.name: startListeningWithPermissionCheck
methods.description: Checks for RECORD_AUDIO permission and initiates speech recognition if permitted.

methods.name: hasRecordAudioPermission
methods.description: Returns whether the app has the RECORD_AUDIO permission.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of permission requests, initiating listening if granted.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up the speech recognizer resources when the activity is destroyed.
